articles.title: EPFO extends September PF filing deadline to October 31: What employers and employees should check
articles.description: The 16-day extension gives employers additional time to comply with the revised provident fund wage ceiling and verify contribution calculations.

articles.title: No meddling as 'middlemen' in forex conversion by banks: New rules forbid conversion of foreign earnings into rupees to detriment of exporters
articles.description: The Foreign Exchange Dealers' Association of India (FEDAI) has directed banks not to convert foreign currency remittances into rupees without specific instructions from the sender or beneficiary. The move follows concerns that intermediary banks were converting dollars at unfavourable exchange rates, leaving small exporters and individuals receiving overseas payments with less money. Banks have also been asked to ensure transparent forex service charges and disclose currency conversion rates on their websites.

articles.title: A Student introduced Mark Hatala to Nvidia before the AI boom. His initial $2,000 investment led to a stake worth over $1 million by 2024
articles.description: A college student introduced Mark Hatala to Nvidia around 2002, prompting an initial investment of about $2,000. More than two decades later, the psychology professor’s Nvidia holdings were worth over $1 million by August 2024, after he bought additional shares and adjusted his position over the years.

articles.description: NiSource’s new 20-year power agreement with Microsoft is expected to lift projected savings for NIPSCO electric customers to $1.75 billion across data-center contracts, alongside plans to add generation and battery-storage capacity.

articles.title: US imports turn costly in September, highest gain in four years: Labour Department report
articles.description: US import prices experienced a notable increase in September driven by higher costs for energy products and various goods. This rise in import costs reflects ongoing inflation pressures exacerbated by the West Asia war. Recent data showed substantial increases in consumer and producer prices, broadening inflation beyond the energy sector. Supply chain disruptions have also been attributed to the prolonged conflict in the region.

articles.title: Bengaluru Metro: BMRCL Begins Soil Testing for Sarjapur-Hebbal Red Line
articles.description: BMRCL has begun preliminary soil testing on Sarjapur Road for Bengaluru Metro’s proposed 37.8 km Sarjapur-Hebbal Red Line. The project awaits Centre’s approval, while officials review costs and refine plans for the corridor.

articles.title: CJP protests hurt CP businesses; restaurant owner seeks damages, ban on Central Park gathering
articles.description: Protests in Connaught Place have disrupted local businesses as some report zero sales on protest days. Restaurant owner Aayush Chopra is legally challenging compensation for losses incurred during the demonstrations. The National Restaurant Association of India notes that consumer fear of protests is discouraging visits to the area. The estimated losses for businesses are significant, impacting employment and operating costs.

articles.title: Yes Bank expects 250 bps reduction in core capital ratio after SC sets aside AT1 bond write-off
articles.description: Yes Bank expects its core capital ratio to decline by 250 basis points following the Supreme Court's decision to overturn the write-off of Rs 8,400 crore worth of AT1 bonds during its 2020 rescue. S&P Global Ratings expects the bank to absorb the impact without an immediate effect on its credit ratings.

articles.title: India Exports First Consignment of Organic Palmyra Jaggery Powder to Bulgaria
articles.description: Gobichettipalayam (Tamil Nadu): India has exported its first consignment of organic Palmyra Jaggery Powder to Bulgaria, marking a step towards expanding international markets for the country’s traditional agricultural products. The Agricultural and Processed Food Products Export Development Authority (APEDA), under the Ministry of Commerce and Industry, facilitated the flag-off of the 1.755-tonne consignment from Gobichettipalayam […] The post India Exports First Consignment of Organic Palmyra Jaggery Powder to Bulgaria appeared first on Revoi.in.

articles.title: Railway panel to examine 21 issues, including passenger safety and station upgrades
articles.description: The Parliamentary Standing Committee on Railways has identified 21 issues for examination in the upcoming financial year. These issues include passenger safety, public facilities, and operational improvements. Additionally, the committee will evaluate business-related activities like land utilization and development of station areas. The government plans to invest in seven high-speed rail corridors to enhance rail connectivity across India.

articles.description: Motilal Oswal Mutual Fund held an AUM of Rs 1.70 lakh crore across 93 funds as of September 30, 2026. According to a report by Motilal Oswal Financial Services, One 97 Communications, Eternal, Kalyan Jewellers, MCX, and Sterlite Technologies featured among the fund house's top 10 equity portfolio holdings.

articles.title: If you only own Indian stocks, what are you missing?
articles.description: Indian investors may hold stocks across several companies yet remain concentrated in a single market. With India accounting for around 3% of global equity market capitalisation in May 2026, international investing offers a broader opportunity set. The key is understanding diversification, currency risk, investment routes and how overseas exposure fits individual financial goals.

articles.title: Rs 10,000 crore for small businesses: Who can benefit from India's new SME Growth Fund?
articles.description: The Union Cabinet has greenlit a substantial Rs 10,000-crore SME Growth Fund dedicated to bolstering small and medium enterprises. This initiative focuses on equity investments in growth-driven manufacturing businesses that demonstrate strong viability and scalability. While the fund's launch is promising, the specifics of how to apply are still under wraps, making its successful impact contingent on the effective expansion of the chosen enterprises.

articles.title: SBI ordered to pay retired scientist Rs 15L after failing to inform about FD maturity
articles.description: A retired scientist took legal action against State Bank of India for failing to inform him about his deposit's maturity. The consumer commission determined that SBI did not communicate properly regarding the deposit and extension options. As a result, the commission found SBI had retained his funds without justification after maturity. The commission ordered the bank to pay him the original deposit amount along with interest.

articles.title: Annual bonus of Rs 6,908 for central government employees: Who qualifies and who will be left out
articles.description: Annual bonus for central government employees On October 15, 2026, the Ministry of Finance introduced a non-Productivity Linked Bonus for central government employees, providing Group 'C' and non-gazetted Group 'B' workers with a bonus equivalent to 30 days of their emoluments, totaling Rs 6,908. Casual laborers who fulfill certain conditions are equally entitled to this non-PLB payment, all amounts finalized by the nearest rupee based on the established calculations.

articles.description: Indian Bank gained Rs 1,388 crore from the NSE listing, boosting second-quarter non-interest income by 50% to Rs 3,953 crore. The one-time gain offset pressure from rising bond yields, despite Rs 123 crore in mark-to-market losses. Meanwhile, Canara Bank and UCO Bank reported declines in other income, reflecting weaker treasury earnings.

articles.title: After causing almost existential crisis for Mathematicians; ChatGPT-maker OpenAI makes a $5 million donation to a foundation working on Maths
articles.description: OpenAI has announced a $5 million donation to the Simons Foundation aimed at supporting mathematicians. This initiative intends to help researchers explore and build on AI-generated mathematical results. The funding will facilitate workshops, conferences, and access to OpenAI's models for researchers. This development follows recent criticism from the Association for Human Mathematics over OpenAI's published mathematical results. The controversy stems from claims concerning illegal plagiarism and scientific norm violations.

The government Wednesday approved the divestment of a majority stake in IDBI Bank to Watsa's Fairfax Financial Holdings. Watsa, 76, who was born near Hyderabad and studied at IIT-Madras, migrated to Canada in the 1970s. Started by him as an insurance company, Fairfax Financial now has assets of over $100 billion. articles.title: Maharashtra FDA chief Tukaram Mundhe bans sale of loose spices
articles.description: Maharashtra Food and Drug Administration has implemented a ban on loose spices to combat adulteration. The ban comes after discovering harmful industrial dyes in local spice samples. Action will be taken against manufacturers who violate the compliance order issued by the FDA. The FDA will also regulate the storage of spices to ensure public health isn't jeopardized.

articles.title: FC Barcelona eyes €300 million and more in annual retail revenue under record Nike partnership until 2038
articles.description: FC Barcelona has extended its strategic alliance with Nike, aiming to significantly increase retail and licensing revenue. With a goal to achieve €300 million annually from merchandise sales in the coming years, this partnership, hailed as the largest in football history, has been in place since 1998, ratified by club members. Together, they will enhance supply-chain processes and boost the international availability of their products.

articles.title: India-US trade pact in last leg of legal drafting, says Piyush Goyal
articles.description: India is currently in the final stages of legal drafting for a trade agreement with the US, which is expected to be operational soon. The agreement, following sessions with US trade representatives, aims to ensure preferential access for Indian exporters. Indian officials hope for tariff stability and seek resolution on outstanding issues before the deal is signed.
